rows.label: Scope
rows.value: Current integration map, data flows and single points of failure. Usually 4 to 8 systems.

rows.label: Duration
rows.value: Two weeks from kickoff, with one discovery session per critical system.

rows.label: Budget
rows.value: Fixed before we start. If you move on to implementation, it's deducted.

rows.label: Deliverable
rows.value: Technical document and presentation: map, prioritized risks and a staged plan.

rows.label: Testing
rows.value: Test cases per critical flow and acceptance criteria agreed in writing.

rows.label: Maintenance plan
rows.value: Monitoring, alerts, API contract versioning and a documented handover.

problem.title: The problem
problem.intro: Your company already has the systems, but they don't communicate.
bullets: The ERP doesn't sync with the ecommerce or the payment gateway.
Every month, someone moves data by hand from one platform to another.
Existing integrations break after an update and nobody knows why.
You need to connect with ARCA, DGI or other tax authorities and can't find anyone to own it.
problem.closing: This produces errors, delays and hidden costs that never show up in the IT budget.

whatWeDo.intro: We design and implement connections between the critical systems of your operation, focused on stability and maintainability.
